description: This Java class PropsHelper provides utility methods for getting, setting, and deleting CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) properties via a PropsServiceClient. It includes methods to retrieve properties as String, int, or boolean, and handles exceptions and default values appropriately.

classes.name: PropsHelper
classes.description: Helper class to simplify getting and setting CPE properties, including conversions from String.

methods.name: getCpeProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property value by key, returns default if not found or error occurs.

methods.name: getCpeIntProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property as an integer, with a default value if not found or invalid.

methods.name: getCpeBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a CPE property as a boolean, with a default value.

methods.name: setCpeProperty
methods.description: Sets a CPE property with String, boolean, int, long, double, or float values.

methods.name: delCpeProperty
methods.description: Deletes a CPE property by key.
